subject.title: fix(plugins): quarantine managed npm projects with missing integrity

question: After live patched-installer proof is attached, should this narrow missing-integrity repair or the broader incomplete-metadata repair in https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/107294 become the canonical fix?
rationale: The candidates differ in recovery breadth, and their current evidence does not conclusively demonstrate which implementation is safer across real upgrade and post-recovery failure paths.

options.title: Choose this narrow repair
options.body: Limit automatic quarantine to the reported state where an installed lock entry exists but its expected integrity metadata is absent.

options.title: Choose the broader classifier
options.body: Use https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/107294 if missing entries, versions, and integrity should share one incomplete-metadata recovery state.

recommendation.title: Choose this narrow repair
recommendation.body: Limit automatic quarantine to the reported state where an installed lock entry exists but its expected integrity metadata is absent.

likelyOwner.reason: He merged the integrity-verification behavior both candidates modify and is the clearest available owner for the canonical implementation choice.
